defaultLocaleRequired: Enter the English text; other languages fall back to it.
slugInvalid: Use lowercase letters, numbers and single hyphens, like intro-to-routing.
itemRequired: Enter the text, or remove the empty line.
timeInvalid: Write the time as minutes and seconds, like 2:15, or 1:02:15 with hours.
urlInvalid: Use a docs path, like /docs/getting-started, or an https:// address.
fileTypeUnsupported: This type of file cannot be attached.
coverTypeUnsupported: This type of image cannot be a cover.
documentTooLarge: The file is too large to import at once. Split it into several files.
documentInvalid: The file is not valid JSON.
documentFormat: This is not a course file written by Export.
documentVersion: This course file was written by a newer version and cannot be read here.
keyUnknown: This field is not part of the course file. Check its spelling.
slugDuplicate: This slug is used twice. Each course needs its own slug, and each lesson needs its own slug within its course.
valueInvalid: This value is missing or has the wrong type.
